newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-GERHARD BERGER TO RETURN AT HOCKENHEIM.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-GERHARD BERGER TO RETURN AT HOCKENHEIM.

text.p: Gerhard Berger will return to Formula One racing at the German Grand Prix at Hockenheim on July 27, the Benetton team said on Friday.
Berger, 37, has missed the last three Grands Prix with sinus problems, but has tested the car and declared himself fully fit for a comeback.

The Austrian said he expected to drive for two or three Austrian Alexander Wurz, who replaced Berger in the Canadian, French and British Grands Prix, has been linked with rival outfit Sauber but has said he was is unwilling to race for anyone else.
"For me, there is no question that I want to concentrate on Benetton," Wurtz, 23, said.
